subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw establish a public after-compaction session-reset API, and if so, is the supported contract only `resetSession(reason?)` for the current session or also the unshipped explicit-key compatibility overload?
rationale: This creates a durable plugin API and session-recovery policy; repository history contains a closed unmerged broader reset proposal, so implementation mechanics cannot determine the intended long-term contract.

options.title: Approve narrow hook API
options.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)` during successful after-compaction hooks, with core-owned deferred execution and no automatic overflow reset in this PR.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Do not add a plugin API and instead retain session resets behind existing gateway and owner-controlled lifecycle paths.

options.title: Sponsor broader lifecycle API
options.body: Explicitly design and document a versioned plugin lifecycle API covering compatibility calls, reset notifications, and overflow recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Expose only current-session `resetSession(reason?)` during successful after-compaction hooks, with core-owned deferred execution and no automatic overflow reset in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects solstead to the compaction/reset hook contract being expanded.
